item.title: Dai Sengo Muramasa -Majin Kakusei-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gesen 18
  • 発売日: 2019-05-31
  • スコア: 6.409999999999999/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 大戦御村正 -魔人覚醒-
  • 英語名: Dai Sengo Muramasa -Majin Kakusei-

あらすじ

There is a sword called Muramasa.

It is characterized by large, undulating ripples, with the front and back ripples aligned.

It is famous for its superb cutting ability. Its performance as a sword is said to be unsurpassed in all ages.

However, none of the swords that have been designated as national treasures have the name “Muramasa” on them.

item.title: Sengoku Hime 6 ~Tenka Kakusei, Shingetsu no Kirameki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gesen 18
  • 発売日: 2015-03-27
  • スコア: 6.94/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 戦極姫6 ～天下覚醒、新月の煌き～
  • 英語名: Sengoku Hime 6 Tenka Kakusei, Shingetsu no Kirameki

别名

  • Game Enhancement Edition One + Two

あらすじ

This is the latest game in Gesen18’s Sengokuhime SLG series. Oda Nobunaga headed to the capital to fight against the Azai and Asakura clans. Houjou Ujiyasu planned to take down the forces led by the Yamanouchi Uesugi clan and claim all of Kantou. Takeda Shingen decided to exile his father Nobutora and take over control of the Takeda clan for himself. Masamune Date set forth to unite the Hokuriku region which had grown increasingly discordant. These famous warriors, along with other clan heads, were supported by two men: the wise strategist Amagi Souma, and the master swordsman Sakaki Tsukasa.

item.title: Tengoku Hime ~Shinsei Tairan Soukai no Hasha-tachi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gesen 18
  • 発売日: 2014-09-26
  • スコア: 7.029999999999999/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 天極姫 ～新世大乱・双界の覇者達～
  • 英語名: Tengoku Hime Shinsei Tairan Soukai no Hasha-tachi

别名

  • 天極姫 ～新世大乱双界の覇者達～

あらすじ

A crossover work featuring heroines from Gesen18’s previous games Sengokuhime (set in the Sengoku period) and Sangokuhime (based on the Romance of the Three Kingdoms).

The main change is that the battle system is now real-time. As a result, you’ll have to note the movement speed of armies, in addition to their attack powers. This allows more strategies to be implemented by the player on the battlefield.

item.title: Sangoku Hime 3 ~Tenka Shinsei~
item.description:

  • 日本語名: 三極姫3 ～天下新生～
  • 英語名: Sangoku Hime 3 Tenka Shinsei

别名

  • 三極姫3 ～天下新生～ 遊戯強化版 パッケージ版

あらすじ

This is a continuation of the Sangokuhime series, with over 350 generals. In addition to the three kingdoms, there’ll be routes for Kouhosuu Gishin (Huangfu Song) and Ryofu Housen (Lu Bu). In the new battle system, up to 18 units can fight simultaneously and there are 6 different general types, which adds more balance. There are also 16 different types of troops which can be employed.
